reply_text: The most recent figure in #north-team for the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is 261 seats, posted by Ilse Varga on Oct 14. Ilse described it as "for your records," and nothing else in the channel confirms it as settled, so you may want to check with her before it goes in the tracker. For reference, the 2025 Amendment No. 1 set the seat count at 185.
